messages:
ryan: New hire here, following the quickstart. First call fails with 403 and the console shows the org has billing enabled. anyone know why?

katie: can you paste the exact error and how you created your API key (personal vs service account)?

ryan: error from app logs:
```
2026-09-10T09:12:01Z ERROR request failed status=403 body=\"{\\\"detail\\\":\\\"key lacks workspace permission: missing 'invoke'\\\"}\"
```
I created the key from the console under "My profile" (personal key).

signup-bot: Welcome! Quickstart tip: personal keys are user-scoped and may not have workspace-level invoke on new orgs. Service keys (in Org Settings > API keys) are recommended for sample apps.

ryan: huh - the console onboarding said "API key created" but didn't call out the scope difference.

billing-bot: Org 'redwood-acme' has billing active. Billing not the blocker here.

katie: two things happening: (1) sample quickstart runs as if it targets workspace-level endpoints and expects a key with workspace.invoke; (2) error text is 403 but docs/consoles imply billing when people see 403 which is confusing.

sherman: workaround: generate a service key: Console -> Settings -> API keys -> Create Service Key (grant scope: invoke). Then set REDWOOD_API_KEY to that value and restart the sample.

ryan: tried service key and restarted container, first call still returns 403 once, then 200 on retry. sample is using the SDK with default retries which hides that it got a permissions error first.

katie: SDK parity note: Go/Node SDKs previously coalesced retried errors; Python surfaced first 403 but post-0.5.0 release they aligned to show full error chain. We should document parity and recommend latest SDK.

devex: action items: (1) update quickstart README to show difference between "personal" and "service" keys and explicit steps to create a service key for demo apps, (2) change sample app to detect key scope and print a clearer message if key lacks workspace.invoke, (3) ensure console onboarding explains key types at creation.

signup-bot: Created ticket RDW-6501 (docs), RDW-6502 (sample app better error), RDW-6503 (console UX for key types).

ryan: thanks all — service key + restart fixed it. small suggestion: the sample could auto-fallback to a client mode that uses user-scoped endpoints when a personal key is detected, to avoid forcing service keys for local dev.

sherman: good suggestion, adding to RDW-6502. closing once docs + sample PRs land. :thumbsup:
